{/* Hero Section */}
WebVox: A voice-first way to use your website. WebVox is a modular, voice-enabled chatbot framework that turns natural speech or text into real actions on your site – searching, booking, ordering, and navigating content. Get Started Free View Documentation
{/* 3D Orbiting Rings */}
{/* Central Glowing Core */}
{/* Floating Particles */}
{/* What WebVox Does Section */}

What WebVox does

Core capabilities that redefine user interaction.

{/* Mic Icon */}

Voice & Chat Assistant

Adds a voice and chat assistant to your existing website or web app, with support for both speech and text.
{/* Sparkles / AI Icon */}

Natural Language Understanding

Understands natural language, detects user intent, and asks clarifying questions when needed.
{/* Database Icon */}

Data Retrieval

Retrieves data from your databases and APIs through a Hasura-powered GraphQL abstraction layer.
{/* Lightning Bolt Icon */}

Action Execution

Executes real backend actions such as placing orders, checking availability, modifying bookings, or tracking deliveries, under strict authorization rules.
{/* Services We Provide Section */}

Services we provide

Comprehensive solutions to power your conversational AI.

Voice & chat interface widget

A customizable, embeddable widget that lets users switch between voice and text, shows real-time feedback, and keeps conversation history across sessions.

GraphQL data abstraction with Hasura

Automatic GraphQL APIs over your SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) using Hasura, giving the chatbot a predictable, secure way to access your data with minimal over-fetching.

Intent-aware orchestration

A backend orchestration layer that classifies queries into information retrieval vs. action execution, plans the right sequence of steps, and routes them to GraphQL or partner APIs.

Secure action execution

Role-based access control, token validation, and schema-level checks ensure only authorized, validated GraphQL queries and mutations run against your systems.

Multi-modal retrieval (RAG + SQL)

Hybrid retrieval that combines structured data (orders, products, inventory) with unstructured content (FAQs, policies) to generate complete, context-aware responses.
{/* Motivation Section */}

Our motivation

Modern websites are powerful but often hard to navigate, especially when users just want to “say what they mean” and get something done. Long forms, nested menus, and rigid chatbots create friction, lower conversion, and exclude users who rely on voice or assistive interfaces.

WebVox exists to close this gap. By combining speech recognition, natural language understanding, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and a Hasura-backed GraphQL layer, WebVox lets any site become voice-ready, task-oriented, and accessible – without forcing you to rewrite your backend.

WebVox is built as a pluggable, multi-tenant framework: you keep control of your data and business logic, while the assistant focuses on understanding users, orchestrating the flow, and safely executing the right actions.

{/* CTA Section */}

Ready to upgrade your website?

Join innovative companies using WebVox Bot to drive engagement.
